subject: Intermittent live-stream gaps during peak — customer escalation and board prep
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@omniretail.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Live streaming gaps and 502s during peak window

David —

We started seeing intermittent gaps in the streaming response for our live-recommendation endpoint this morning (around 8:45am PT) that coincide with our promotional blast. Client-side logs show sequences of partial payloads then a long silence (~6-12s) and finally a 502 returned in some cases. Latency and token throughput dropped significantly for ~18 minutes.

Attached: pcap_snippet.txt (small trace), 500s-sample.png (client error snapshot).

This is impacting our checkout assistance demo and the PMs are escalated to our VP. We need an urgent explanation and a mitigation plan — is this related to the chunked-transfer configuration you rolled out last quarter?

—Amit
OmniRetail — Head of Integrations
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Live streaming gaps and 502s during peak window

- Short-term customer mitigation (routing, config rollback, dedicated pool)

David
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Live streaming gaps and 502s during peak window

David / team — quick findings from initial triage (logs + pcap):

- Evidence of proxy buffer pressure during sustained high RPS from OmniRetail (burst ~1.8k RPS sustained for ~12 minutes).
- Chunked transfer stream shows many small frames followed by coalescing delays at the edge proxy; in several traces the WS/TCP keepalive was interrupted when intermediate stream buffers reached threshold (we see TCP retransmits + rst in ~0.5% of connections).
- Error rate spike correlates with GC spikes on the model worker (weaker effect) but primary signal points to proxy backlog and chunk-size fragmentation leading to timeouts on our gateway.

Immediate mitigations we can run now (recommended order):
1) Route OmniRetail traffic to a dedicated pool with increased socket buffer sizes and bump keepalive timeouts (temporary config change).
2) Enable chunk coalescing at the edge (reduce number of tiny frames; hold small writes for up to 50ms to combine).
3) Apply short-lived autoscale bump for model workers + pin a slightly older quantized variant (lower mem pressure) to reduce GC churn for the next 2 hours.

I will open an ops incident and run the routing change now if approved. Attaching mitigation-runbook.md (short runbook) and a sample pcap_snippet.txt.

—Monica
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@omniretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Live streaming gaps and 502s during peak window

Amit —

Thanks for the quick report and the traces. Monica's team has a mitigation plan and is ready to act. Immediate steps we'll take in the next 20–30 minutes:

- Route your traffic to a dedicated pool (no routing change required on your side).
- Enable chunk coalescing at the edge and increase keepalive so your clients won't see small-frame silences.
- We'll monitor a 1-hour observation window and share a timeline and a postmortem.

We will also proactively apply a modest service credit for today while we investigate — Lauren will follow up on that.

Please confirm if we should proceed now.

—David
